title: Roman Conquest of Britain
description: The Roman Empire began its invasion of Britain under Emperor Claudius.

title: Boudica's Revolt
description: Queen Boudica led a rebellion against Roman rule in Britain.

title: Hadrian's Wall Built
description: The Romans built a defensive wall across northern England.

title: Romans Leave Britain
description: The last Roman legions withdrew from Britain.

title: Viking Raid on Lindisfarne
description: Viking raiders attacked the monastery at Lindisfarne.

title: Alfred the Great Becomes King
description: Alfred became King of Wessex and fought the Viking invaders.

title: Battle of Hastings
description: William the Conqueror defeated King Harold II at Hastings.

title: Domesday Book Completed
description: William the Conqueror ordered a survey of all land and property.

title: University of Oxford Teaching Begins
description: Teaching at Oxford began in the late eleventh century.

title: Magna Carta Signed
description: King John sealed the Magna Carta limiting royal power.

title: University of Cambridge Founded
description: Scholars left Oxford to found a new university at Cambridge.

title: Simon de Montfort's Parliament
description: Simon de Montfort summoned a parliament with elected representatives.

title: Peasants' Revolt
description: English peasants rebelled against the poll tax and feudal oppression.

title: Wars of the Roses Begin
description: The houses of York and Lancaster fought for the English throne.

title: Battle of Bosworth Field
description: Henry Tudor defeated Richard III ending the Wars of the Roses.

title: Tudor Dynasty Begins
description: Henry VII became the first Tudor king of England.

title: Church of England Established
description: Henry VIII broke with Rome and created the Church of England.

title: Dissolution of the Monasteries
description: Henry VIII closed England's monasteries and seized their wealth.

title: Mary Rose Sinks
description: The warship Mary Rose sank in the Solent during battle.

title: Elizabeth I Crowned
description: Elizabeth I became Queen of England at age 25.

title: Drake Circumnavigates the Globe
description: Sir Francis Drake completed the first English voyage around the world.

title: Spanish Armada Defeated
description: The English fleet defeated the Spanish Armada sent to invade.

title: Globe Theatre Opens
description: Shakespeare's company opened the Globe Theatre on the Thames.

title: East India Company Founded
description: English merchants founded a company to trade with the East Indies.

title: Union of the Crowns
description: James VI of Scotland became James I of England.

title: Gunpowder Plot Foiled
description: Catholics plotted to blow up Parliament in the Gunpowder Plot.

title: Shakespeare's First Folio
description: Thirty-six of Shakespeare's plays were published together.

title: English Civil War Begins
description: Parliament and King Charles I went to war.

title: Charles I Executed
description: King Charles I was executed after being convicted of treason.

title: Cromwell Becomes Lord Protector
description: Oliver Cromwell took power as Lord Protector of the Commonwealth.

title: Monarchy Restored
description: Charles II returned from exile and restored the monarchy.

title: Great Fire of London
description: A fire destroyed much of the City of London.

title: Newton Publishes Principia
description: Isaac Newton published his laws of motion and gravity.

title: Glorious Revolution
description: William of Orange replaced James II as king.

title: Bill of Rights Passed
description: Parliament passed the Bill of Rights limiting royal power.

title: Bank of England Founded
description: The Bank of England was established to manage government finances.

title: Act of Union Creates Great Britain
description: England and Scotland united into the Kingdom of Great Britain.

title: Battle of Culloden
description: Government forces crushed the Jacobite rebellion at Culloden.

title: British Museum Opens
description: The British Museum opened as the first national public museum.

title: Spinning Jenny Invented
description: James Hargreaves invented the spinning jenny for weaving.

title: Watt Patents the Steam Engine
description: James Watt patented an improved steam engine.

title: First Fleet Sails to Australia
description: The First Fleet carried convicts to establish a colony in Australia.

title: Battle of Trafalgar
description: Nelson defeated the French and Spanish fleets at Trafalgar.

title: Slave Trade Act
description: Britain abolished the transatlantic slave trade.

title: Battle of Waterloo
description: British and allied forces defeated Napoleon at Waterloo.

title: Peterloo Massacre
description: Cavalry charged a reform rally in Manchester killing several people.

title: First Public Railway Opens
description: The Stockton and Darlington Railway opened as the first public railway.

title: Metropolitan Police Founded
description: Sir Robert Peel founded the Metropolitan Police in London.

title: Great Reform Act
description: The Reform Act extended the vote to more men.

title: Slavery Abolition Act
description: Britain abolished slavery throughout most of its empire.

title: Queen Victoria Crowned
description: Victoria became Queen of the United Kingdom.

title: People's Charter Published
description: Chartists published demands for universal male suffrage.

title: Penny Black Stamp Issued
description: The Penny Black became the world's first adhesive postage stamp.

title: Great Famine Begins in Ireland
description: Potato blight triggered mass starvation in Ireland.

title: Public Health Act
description: The first Public Health Act addressed sanitation in British cities.

title: Great Exhibition Opens
description: The Great Exhibition showcased industry at the Crystal Palace.

title: Crimean War Begins
description: Britain and France fought Russia in the Crimea.

title: Nightingale Serves at Scutari
description: Florence Nightingale improved hospital care during the Crimean War.

title: Origin of Species Published
description: Charles Darwin published his theory of evolution.

title: London Underground Opens
description: The Metropolitan Railway opened as the world's first underground railway.

title: Football Association Founded
description: The Football Association was founded in London.

title: Second Reform Act
description: The vote was extended to more working-class men.

title: First Wimbledon Championship
description: The first Wimbledon tennis tournament was held.

title: Tower Bridge Opens
description: Tower Bridge across the Thames was opened by the Prince of Wales.

title: Suffragette Movement Founded
description: Emmeline Pankhurst founded the Women's Social and Political Union.

title: Entente Cordiale Signed
description: Britain and France settled colonial disputes with an agreement.

title: HMS Dreadnought Launched
description: The revolutionary battleship HMS Dreadnought was launched.

title: Old Age Pensions Introduced
description: The government began paying pensions to the over-70s.

title: Scott Reaches the South Pole
description: Robert Falcon Scott reached the South Pole on a doomed expedition.

title: Britain Enters World War I
description: Britain declared war on Germany after the invasion of Belgium.

title: Battle of the Somme
description: The Somme offensive caused huge British casualties.

title: Women Win the Vote
description: The Representation of the People Act gave women the vote.

title: World War I Ends
description: The armistice ended fighting on the Western Front.

title: BBC Founded
description: The British Broadcasting Company was founded in London.

title: General Strike
description: Millions of workers struck over miners' pay and conditions.

title: Penicillin Discovered
description: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin's antibiotic properties.

title: BBC Begins Television Broadcasts
description: The BBC launched the world's first regular television service.

title: Jarrow March
description: Unemployed workers marched from Jarrow to London.

title: Dunkirk Evacuation
description: Allied troops were evacuated from the beaches of Dunkirk.

title: Battle of Britain
description: The RAF defeated the Luftwaffe in the skies over Britain.

title: The Blitz Begins
description: German bombers launched sustained attacks on British cities.

title: Beveridge Report Published
description: The Beveridge Report proposed a welfare state after the war.

title: D-Day Landings
description: British and Allied forces landed on the beaches of Normandy.

title: National Health Service Founded
description: The NHS began providing free healthcare to all.

title: Empire Windrush Arrives
description: The Empire Windrush brought Caribbean migrants to London.

title: Festival of Britain
description: The Festival of Britain celebrated national recovery.

title: Everest Summit
description: Hillary and Tenzing became the first to reach the summit of Everest.

title: Coronation of Elizabeth II
description: Elizabeth II was crowned at Westminster Abbey.

title: England Win the World Cup
description: England won the FIFA World Cup at Wembley.

title: Decimal Day
description: Britain switched to a decimal currency.

title: Bloody Sunday
description: British soldiers shot protesters in Derry Northern Ireland.

title: Sex Discrimination Act
description: The Act made sex discrimination in employment unlawful.

title: First Test-Tube Baby Born
description: Louise Brown became the first baby born through IVF.

title: Falklands War
description: Britain fought Argentina over the Falkland Islands.

title: Miners' Strike
description: British miners struck against planned pit closures.

title: Channel Tunnel Opens
description: The Channel Tunnel linked Britain and France by rail.

title: Scottish Parliament Reconvened
description: Devolution created a new Scottish Parliament in Edinburgh.

title: London Hosts the Olympics
description: London staged the 2012 Summer Olympics.

title: Scottish Independence Referendum
description: Scotland voted to remain part of the United Kingdom.

title: Brexit Referendum
description: The UK voted to leave the European Union.
